avis.titre: Skin is soft and safe for sensitivity
avis.texte: I loved using this serum under my everyday moisturizer. It never broke me out and always absorbed nicely into my skin. I noticed after the first week my skin was very soft and helped minimize texture. I wish there was more product for the price because this lasted only a month.
High-quality products that helped my dry sensitive rosacea skin.

I have incredibly sensitive skin - this is the best serum i have found that does not cause irritation at all! It feels like a drink of water on the skin - actually soaks into the skin (instead if sitting on top!) and you can truly feel the hydration. 10/10!

I received this serum complimentary from Murad! I paired this with their repair cream and it's been doing wonders for my dry and flaky skin! I absolutely will be restocking as soon as possible! It's so good!

I love how silky smooth this serum applies onto the skin. It makes my skin feel so soft when I apply it at night and then wake up in the morning. I also love the way it has made my skin feel bouncier. Gifted by murad.

I love how silky smooth this serum applies onto the skin. It makes my skin feel so soft when I apply it at night and then wake up in the morning. I also love the way it has made my skin feel bouncier. Gifted by murad.

avis.titre: Not game changing but still a great option!
avis.texte: I usually love any Murad product that I try. I didn't notice a huge difference right away. I didn't really enjoy the scent either. After using it for about a week, I started to notice that my dry skin was a bit moisturized. The product was a bit thin but that did make for it to easily massage into my skin.

Effective and left my skin texture feeling good but not great. I prefer products with a scent that is more fresh or prevalent but it isn't bad. I'd say this is a good product for the value but nothing insanely impressive.
Overall the serum helped a little bit after washing my face. It truly did help retain the moisture. The bottle was very easy to use and it did also look very nice, the color is cute.

(influenceter has been asking me to review this for a month but i just received it) i love the packaging for the price i think it is small tho, it gives me the same vibes as the supergoop glow lotion also the same smell and consistency of it. it works pretty well very lightweight and hydrating

This product is amazing for repairing your skin barrier! In recommend this for anyone with dry skin. The texture is very smooth, and it makes your skin look like glass. The scent isn't overbearing, overall a good serum.

avis.titre: Perfect For Dry, Sensitive, and Mature Skin
avis.texte: Thanks to Murad and Influenster for sending me this free product in exchange for my honest review. This Murad Cellular Hydration Repair Serum it's absolutely awesome! I love that it glides on smoothly. It's not greasy and has a slight skin care scent. I can't believe how hydrating and moisturizing this serum was by itself without adding any other products. I have noticed that it has helped hydrate my skin during these cold winter months when my skin would normally be very dry. Since I am 48 years old, I truly believe this is a wonderful product for sensitive and mature skin.
This product blends in nicely. I kind of wish it gave me more of a glow after using it. But it hasn't caused any problems for my skin, so that's good.

ive been loving this serum ! I use retinol almost daily, which can be harsh on my skin. This serum does a great job at restoring any irritation or broken skin barrier. I usually apply it at night followed by moisutirzer. It does have an interesting smell, but its tolerable and goes away after application! gifted by murad

I had never tried anything from this brand prior to this project and was pleasantly surprised with the brand and how well it worked. You have to apply it before your moisturizer and with some other products i have tried it left me feeling really cakey and thick on my face but not with this. Even with the extra layer my skin still felt light and i had do weird flaking or drying on my face. I would definitely recommend this to my friends.

This is a game-changer! It effectively hydrates my skin without leaving any greasy residue, leaving it feeling refreshed and supple. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly, and the subtle scent is quite pleasant. I've noticed a significant improvement in my skin's overall texture and appearance since incorporating this toner into my skincare routine. Highly recommended for anyone looking to boost hydration levels!
The new formula works great, but it smells awful. I quickly apply the moisturizer and the smell goes away. I would only recommend this product only If someone's skin was as dry as mine.

I like this serum, and it's my first experience with Murad. I use it morning and night under moisturizer. I don't love the scent, but it's tolerable. Dry skin will need more moisture, but in warmer months for this product will be fine. I think it's a little expensive for the 1 oz product quantity, though the external plastic packaging is huge.

avis.titre: I would add to my routine!
